title: japofc-qr toJSON() document
description: Shape of the plain object returned by QrCode.toJSON() and accepted by QrCode.fromJSON(). The format is additive-only within a major version: fields may be added, never renamed or removed.

generator.description: Package name, so a document can be traced back to its producer.

size.description: Module count per side. Always version * 4 + 17.

modules.description: One '0'/'1' string per row, '1' marking a dark module.
